messages:
Aisha: Quick thread to scope a small MVP: per-route cost heatmap + lightweight trace hook + CSV export. Target: reduce customer confusion about model routing costs.
Cam: Sounds good. Key constraint: keep ingest overhead minimal. Propose aggregated rollups + sampled spans.
Jordan: UX: heatmap with model (rows) x route (cols). Color = estimated cost per 1k tokens. Click a cell -> show sample traces if any.
Len: Tracing: emit tiny span tags: model, route, tokens, quant_variant. Default sampling 0.5% hosted / 1% dedicated. Provide per-org toggle.
Maria: CS: Add CSV export with an "impact" column (est. monthly savings if switching models). Enterprise wants S3 export + PII masking.
Aisha: MVP scope list: heatmap UI + filters, CSV export (30d), trace hook & sampling UI, error bucket counts. Enterprise S3 export gated.
Cam: Rollout: canary 10% non-enterprise for 14d, monitor p95 latency & ingest delta. Fallback to per-minute aggregates if ingest too high.
Jordan: Launch acceptance: p95 latency regression <2%, ingest delta <5% for typical customers, CSV export works, sampling toggle visible.
Len: Infra checklist: span schema, sampling config, aggregate fallback. I'll draft infra spec by EOD tomorrow.
Maria: I'll confirm export/PII requirements with AcmeHealth + one other customer and share notes.
OpsBot: Canary started for cohort at 1777777775 :rocket:
Aisha: Thanks team. Follow-up in #product next Tuesday to lock timeline.
